<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.

- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>

## Problem
Changes to the supplier list within the claims-handling software can unintentionally break established reporting flows. This is a critical issue because accurate and reliable reports are essential for tracking claims accurately and enabling timely business decisions.

## Who is affected
- The account Brantwick Commercial has been directly affected, as their support inquiry indicates a disruption linked to a supplier list change [i:916bfbc7e76d15e8].

## Evidence
The problem was identified through a support inquiry from Brantwick Commercial. A user from this account asked, "Could that have broken the reporting flow?" in relation to a change that was made, indicating a direct link between a supplier list update and a reporting failure [i:916bfbc7e76d15e8]. This is the only mention of the issue across all support channels, as the fact sheet shows 1 total mention, all routed through support [i:916bfbc7e76d15e8].

## Why now
The issue was raised on 2026-09-22 [i:916bfbc7e76d15e8]. With Brantwick Commercial's renewal date set for 2027-05-11 and an Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of £150,000, the integrity of their reporting is crucial for ongoing operations and renewal confidence. The fact that there have been 0 renewals in the last 90 days underscores the importance of maintaining system reliability to prevent churn risk. The problem's impact on a high-value account makes it a current priority.
</previous_draft>
